physicalEvidence.summary: Physical0: full 12-page L4DC 2025 Deep Source-Seekers paper uses a 60×100-pixel two-dimensional simulation. A VGG-inspired complexity adapter selects YOLOv10 or RT-DETR to estimate robot coordinates inside a hybrid extremum-seeking/obstacle-avoidance controller. Real-world background images and synthetic occlusion overlays are not physical vehicle execution. No real land robot or ocean vessel deployment is established. The lead author Carolyn/Xiyuan Zhang is independently listed as a current Poveda-advised PhD researcher, so this is current directed robotics-AI work, not just historical theory or incidental coauthorship.
